description: Convert a JSON array of objects into CSV. The union of all keys becomes the header row in first-seen order, missing keys become empty cells, and nested objects or arrays are written back as compact JSON in the cell. Output follows RFC 4180 quoting. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/json-to-csv/
